    AI Overview
    For American Idol 2026 (Season 24),
    voting opens during live broadcasts, generally starting at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on Mondays. Fans can vote up to 10 times per contestant/method via AmericanIdol.com/Vote, text message to 21523, and by commenting on official pinned posts on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. 
    How to Vote: American Idol Season 24 (2026) 
    • Website: Visit idolvote.abc.com to register and vote.
    • Text: Text the specific contestant’s voting number to 21523.
    • Social Media: Follow the official @AmericanIdol accounts on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok for the "Official Vote Post" and comment to vote. 
    Voting Rules & Requirements 
    • Eligibility: Must be 16 or older and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
    • Limit: Up to 10 votes per contestant, per voting method.
    • Timing: Voting typically opens at the start of the show and closes shortly after, usually by the end of the broadcast. 
    Note: The previous "American Idol App" is discontinued for 2026, requiring fans to use the website, text, or social media.
